So this post takes the agentic engineering discipline and rebuilds the AI development workflow from scratch — three-layer documentation (Spec / Plan / Tasks via CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md, ROADMAP, tasks.md templates), AI employee division of labor (Skill vs Sub-agent vs Agent Teams), development discipline (tests in the same turn, UI delegation, Conventional Commits), two-layer wrap-up validation (typecheck + test + build, plus Writer/Reviewer mode and AI citation cross-checks), a rollback decision table, and a two-tier Memory + CLAUDE.md architecture. The whole thing runs end-to-end against a personal e-commerce MVP (Nuxt 3 + Supabase + Stripe), including how to defuse the classic Stripe-checkout client-price-tampering security trap.
